body.title: MetaRewrite type, metaRewrites field and exported short-name helpers
body.summary: Add the exported MetaRewrite interface ({ artifactId, jsonPath, groupHash, set: { epicSlug?, epicCreatedAt?, standalone?: true }, mdEdits: { file, from, to }[], companionNotes: string[] }) and `readonly metaRewrites: readonly MetaRewrite[]` on MigrationPlan in src/workflow/migrate-docs-tree.ts; every return site of planMigration returns metaRewrites (empty for now). Export epicShortName (define.ts) and hldShortName (hld.ts) unchanged in behaviour so the planner can rebuild DEF/HLD H1 lines with the renderers' own rule.
acceptanceChecks: tsc passes; MigrationPlan carries metaRewrites at every planMigration return
epicShortName and hldShortName are exported and the DEF/HLD renderers' output is unchanged (existing define/hld tests pass)

tests.name: t1: MigrationPlan from planMigration carries metaRewrites (empty for a repo with no artifacts)
t1: epicShortName / hldShortName exported: slug when set, else first sentence / first line
